name: Fuel Ki (Ki)
body:
You can tap the living strength of your body to fuel your ki.

Prerequisite(s): Con 13, Wis 13, ki pool class feature or Ki Meditation

Benefit(s): As a full-round action, you can regain 2 ki points at a cost of 2 points of ability damage to your Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution. This ability damage bypasses any resistance or immunity to ability damage that you possess. You cannot exceed your normal maximum daily ki points with this feat; excess ki points are lost.

Special: Creatures lacking a Strength or Constitution score cannot use those ability scores to fuel their ki.
